description: This file contains the implementation of the XGraphics class in the PDFsharp library, which provides a surface for drawing operations on various types of graphics contexts including GDI, WPF, and PDF pages. It includes constructors for different drawing targets, methods for drawing lines, curves, Bézier splines, and arcs, and manages graphics state and coordinate transformations.
external_methods: geometry creation methods such as GeometryHelper.CreateCurveSegment

classes.name: XGraphics
classes.description: Represents a drawing surface for a fixed size page or graphics context, providing methods for drawing primitives, managing state, and handling different rendering targets.

classes.name: InternalGraphicsMode
classes.description: Flags indicating the current graphics mode like GDI, PDF Content, or Bitmap.

methods.name: CreateMeasureContext
methods.description: Creates a measure-only graphics context for measuring text and graphics without rendering.

methods.name: FromGraphics
methods.description: Creates an XGraphics from a System.Drawing.Graphics object (GDI+).

methods.name: FromDrawingContext
methods.description: Creates an XGraphics from a WPF DrawingContext.

methods.name: FromCanvas
methods.description: Creates an XGraphics from a WPF Canvas.

methods.name: FromPdfPage
methods.description: Creates an XGraphics for drawing on a PDF page.

methods.name: FromPdfForm
methods.description: Creates an XGraphics from an XPdfForm.

methods.name: FromForm
methods.description: Creates an XGraphics from an XForm.

methods.name: FromImage
methods.description: Creates an XGraphics from an XImage, if supported.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources used by the XGraphics instance.

methods.name: DrawLine
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with specified pen.

methods.name: DrawBezier
methods.description: Draws a Bézier spline with four points.

methods.name: DrawBeziers
methods.description: Draws multiple Bézier splines from an array of points.

methods.name: DrawCurve
methods.description: Draws a cardinal spline through a set of points with optional tension.

methods.name: DrawArc
methods.description: Draws an arc representing a portion of an ellipse.

methods.name: DrawRectangle
methods.description: Draws rectangles with overloads for different rectangle types and coordinates, supporting stroke and fill options.

methods.name: DrawEllipse
methods.description: Draws ellipses defined by bounding rectangles, with support for strokes and fills.

methods.name: DrawPolygon
methods.description: Draws polygons defined by arrays of points with overloads for different point types and fill modes.

methods.name: DrawPie
methods.description: Draws pie slices defined by ellipses, supporting stroke, fill, and combinations.

methods.name: DrawClosedCurve
methods.description: Draws closed cardinal splines through points with optional tension and fill options.

methods.name: DrawPath
methods.description: Draws graphical paths with stroke, fill, and combined options.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Draws text strings at specified points with formatting options.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Various overloads to draw text strings at specified positions with different formatting and layout options. Handles platform-specific differences via conditional compilation and checks for null arguments, and includes support for underline, strikeout, and baseline alignment.

methods.name: MeasureString
methods.description: Measures the size of a string when rendered with a specified font and formatting, including support for rendering events and glyph index processing.

methods.name: DrawImage
methods.description: Multiple overloads to draw images at specific points, rectangles, or with specific source and destination rectangles, supporting platform-specific images (GDI, WPF), with checks for nulls and PDF form placeholders.

methods.name: DrawMissingImageRect
methods.description: Draws a red rectangle with diagonals indicating a missing or unsupported image.

methods.name: CheckXPdfFormConsistence
methods.description: Ensures that images derived from XForm objects are properly finished and bound to the correct owner document context.

methods.name: DisassociateImage
methods.description: Removes association with the current image, disposing of resources if any.

methods.name: InternalGraphicsMode
methods.description: Property for getting and setting the current internal graphics mode.

methods.name: AssociatedImage
methods.description: Property for getting and setting the currently associated image object.

methods.name: AppendToContentStream
methods.description: Adds a string command to the internal content stream when rendering to PDF.

methods.name: WorldToDefaultPage
methods.description: Transforms a rectangle in world space to the default page space, considering current transformation matrices.

methods.name: WorldToDefaultPage
methods.description: Transforms a point from world space to the default page coordinate space.
